current_evidence: Not verified: the shared WebFetch budget (400/hour across all agents) and the WebSearch budget were exhausted before any Ashford page could be fetched, so the live list and its date could not be checked.

issues.detail: Nearly every requirement is placed under 'Full planning' with the 'INFERRED... placed under Full planning' note (Air Quality, SuDS, Ecology, EIA, Fire Statement, FRA, Stodmarsh/HRA, Heritage, Self-build, Transport, Travel Plan). Householder, Outline, s73 and prior approval all get '(none)'. The extracted text shows triggers that cover other types: Stodmarsh nutrient neutrality (LV10) applies to 'All applications for new housing and overnight accommodation within the Stour Catchment', including Outline and prior approval; residential space standards and external open space apply to 'All new dwellings'; the EV charging excerpt describes what an outline application must show, yet it is placed only under Reserved matters.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'LV10 Stodmarsh Mitigation Strategy All applications for new housing and overnight accommodation within the Stour Catchment Area...'; EV excerpt: '...a commitment that when reserved matters are submitted they will be accompanied with the requisite level of detail'.

issues.detail: LV17 Tree survey / AIA is placed under 'Works to trees', but the excerpt is the planning-application requirement for proposals that involve works to protected or other trees as part of the development. It should sit under Full, Outline and Householder. LV18 Structural Survey is placed only under Listed building consent, but its trigger also covers conversion of agricultural buildings (Full planning / prior approval).
issues.evidence: 'LV17 Tree survey... where works are proposed to any trees as part of the proposals'; 'LV18 Structural Survey Required for: ... or the conversion of agricultural buildings.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are fragments or describe content rather than when the item applies: Air Quality ('exceeded and Air Quality Assessment must be provided as set out in policy ENV12.') loses the threshold; EIA ('whether an Environmental Statement is required.'); SuDS (design guidance on multifunctional benefits, no trigger); Ecology (report content only); Transport/Travel Plan (generic definitions). The 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' excerpt merges four separate requirements with different thresholds into one cut-off string: dwelling mix for majors of 10+ dwellings, external open space for all new dwellings, space standards for all new dwellings, accessibility standards for 5+ new-build dwellings.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows excerpts as quoted; 'LV14 Residential Space Standards Compliance Checklist Dwelling mix - Major residential schemes of 10 or more dwellings ... Accessibility Standards - Schemes of 5 or more new build dwellings'.

issues.detail: Mislabelled requirement: the 'Block plan / Site plan' row is actually the HOU18 dwelling-mix requirement (a detailed list and block plan showing dwelling types and sizes for majors of 10+ dwellings), not a general block plan requirement. The 'Self-build' trigger is correctly captured (40+ units in Ashford/Tenterden, 20+ in villages/rural areas).
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'list and block plan must be provided to show the amount and location of dwelling types and sizes in accordance with Policy HOU18.'

issues.detail: 'Heritage Statement' and 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning use the identical excerpt.
issues.evidence: Both rows: 'Heritage Statement It should include a schedule of works to the heritage asset(s)...'.

issues.detail: Two of the three tab_items are fragments rather than requirements: a run-on of policy references ('TRA8 – Travel Plans, Assessment and Statements Chapter 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework LV10 Stodmarsh...') and 'Identify suitable mitigation to achieve nutrient Find out more about nutrient neutrality .'

Biodiversity Net Gain information appears only as a tab_item about the UKHAB habitat plan and has no requirement row under any application type (Full, Outline, Householder-exempt etc.). More widely, LV codes in the extracted text run to at least LV18, but only about 14 distinct requirements were captured, so other local items are probably missing. This could not be confirmed against the live source because the fetch budget was exhausted.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'A scaled plan(s) (UKHAB V2.0 preferred, with north arrow) showing ... post-development on-site habitat'; LV10, LV13, LV14, LV17, LV18 seen in excerpts.

summary: The source could not be fetched (shared web budget exhausted), so currency and completeness are unverified and the list is undated in the workbook. Grokbot's own data shows weak extraction: nearly everything is guessed into Full planning, Stodmarsh and dwelling standards are missing from Outline and other residential types, several triggers are fragments or merged, and BNG has no requirement row.
